# Oons

> Women-first home services for Greater Cairo — beauty, home cleaning, and food,
> delivered by vetted female professionals with an escrow-backed booking flow.

Oons (أُنس) is a booking app. This host serves the customer web app; most
content is rendered client-side after sign-in.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://lady.oons.app/): browse services and start a booking
- [Marketing site](https://oons.app/): what Oons is, for whom, and how it works
- [Legal](https://oons.app/legal/privacy): privacy policy and terms

## Notes

- Booking, profiles, and account data require phone-OTP authentication.
- For provider onboarding see https://oons.app/provider/.
